import ast, csv, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, re, subprocess, textwrap
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
base = "bb6e7ccca41fe00a06815d81e174c5261e7a1ce3"
pinned = "a04446e57ec1fbc252a871afcec7752fb2807b14"
checks = []
def blob(ref, path):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "show", ref + ":" + path], check=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30).stdout
def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest().upper()
contracts = {
    "ega/dec.csv": ("decision_id", "D", 328, 329),
    "ega/smap.csv": ("edge_id", "S", 1249, 1259),
    "ega/resid.csv": ("residual_id", "R", 825, 829),
    "ega/agent.csv": ("run_id", "A", 256, 257),
}
for path, (field, prefix, old_count, new_count) in contracts.items():
    old = blob(base, path)
    current = (root / path).read_bytes()
    assert current.startswith(old), path
    assert current.endswith(b"\n") and b"\r" not in current, path
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(current.decode("utf-8"))))
    assert len(rows) == new_count and not any(None in row for row in rows), path
    assert [row[field] for row in rows[old_count:]] == [
        f"{prefix}{number:06}" for number in range(old_count + 1, new_count + 1)], path
    checks.append({"check": "append_only_prefix_and_exact_rows", "path": path, "status": "PASS",
                   "old_bytes": len(old), "old_sha256": sha(old), "append_bytes": len(current)-len(old),
                   "append_sha256": sha(current[len(old):])})
old_tex = blob(base, "schemes.tex")
tex = (root / "schemes.tex").read_bytes()
pattern = re.compile(rb"\\begin\{lemma\}\n\\label\{lemma-quasi-compact-preserved-base-change\}\n.*?\\end\{proof\}\n", re.S)
old_blocks = pattern.findall(old_tex)
new_blocks = pattern.findall(tex)
assert len(old_blocks) == len(new_blocks) == 1
assert old_tex.replace(old_blocks[0], new_blocks[0]) == tex
assert sha(new_blocks[0]) == "CA7C24394395B46209676363A9C0018C2203A6A9E41768372CE567BB4E850123"
marker = b"\\begin{proof}\n"
assert old_blocks[0].split(marker)[0] == new_blocks[0].split(marker)[0]
proof = marker + new_blocks[0].split(marker, 1)[1]
assert len(proof) == 1000 and sha(proof) == "0EB645C0B0EBFA0479A4D5A0B55074AA1C588832F33F29DF3FA18A942AA3B861"
assert proof.count(b"{") == proof.count(b"}") and proof.count(b"$") % 2 == 0
refs = re.findall(rb"\\ref\{([^}]+)\}", proof)
assert refs == [b"lemma-quasi-compact-affine", b"lemma-affine-covering-fibre-product", b"lemma-quasi-compact-affine"]
for ref in set(refs):
    label = b"\\label{" + ref + b"}"
    assert tex.count(label) == 1 and tex.index(label) < tex.index(new_blocks[0])
assert blob(base, "tags/tags") == (root / "tags/tags").read_bytes()
checks.append({"check": "only_unique_01K5_proof_changes_statement_and_tags_preserved_dependencies_prior_and_resolved",
               "status": "PASS", "proof_bytes":len(proof), "proof_sha256":sha(proof),
               "file_bytes":len(tex), "file_sha256":sha(tex)})
scope = json.loads((root / "ega/scope.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
checker = (root / "ega/check.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
ast.parse(checker)
start = checker.index("    i664_label =")
end = checker.index('    if any(units_by_id[row["source_unit"]]["kind"] in {', start)
guard = textwrap.dedent(checker[start:end])
pinned_tex = blob(pinned, "schemes.tex")
def guard_errors(raw, fixed=pinned_tex):
    env={"i664_root_raw":raw,"re":re,"hashlib":hashlib,"scope":scope,
         "git_blob":lambda *args: fixed,
         "expected_i664_source_slice":scope["reviewed_source_slices"]["ega:I.6.6.4"], "ERRORS":[]}
    exec(compile(guard, "adopted_i664_proof_guard", "exec"), env)
    return env["ERRORS"]
assert not guard_errors(tex)
label = rb"\label{lemma-quasi-compact-preserved-base-change}"
dep = rb"\label{lemma-quasi-compact-affine}"
adverse = {
    "omitted_proof_reversion":old_tex,
    "duplicate_target_label":tex+b"\n"+label+b"\n",
    "missing_target_label":tex.replace(label,b""),
    "statement_mutation":tex.replace(b"Being quasi-compact is a property",b"Being flat is a property",1),
    "proof_mutation":tex.replace(b"the right hand side is a finite affine open covering.",b"the right hand side is an affine open covering.",1),
    "missing_dependency":tex.replace(dep,b""),
    "forward_dependency":tex.replace(dep,b"")+b"\n"+dep+b"\n",
}
for name, raw in adverse.items():
    errors=guard_errors(raw)
    assert errors, name
    checks.append({"check":"adversarial_"+name,"status":"PASS_REJECTED","errors":errors})
checks.append({"check":"adopted_guard_positive_case_and_checker_AST","status":"PASS"})
print(json.dumps({"schema":"ega-i-6.6.4-local-structural-check/v1","status":"PASS","checks":checks},indent=2))
